correctness.rationale: The explicit vertex map from the deleted-apex independence complex to the full shadow simplex sends each original vertex to its shadow and preserves simplices. Every face union with its image is again independent, giving a canonical Aut(G)-equivariant contiguity deformation retraction; the shadow simplex contracts equivariantly to its invariant barycenter. The apex star is exactly a cone on Ind(G), with intersection the original Ind(G), and the equivariant homotopy pushout gives the unreduced suspension. Induction gives all iterations; fixed-space and quotient consequences follow from the genuine equivariant homotopy equivalence. The orbit-conflict model is a simplexwise barycentric homeomorphism. The complete n≤4 graph/automorphism check, second iterations and dihedral full group are corroboration, not an infinite or integral proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected Goyal–Shukla–Singh Theorem 4.1 and Carnero Bravo Theorem 5/Corollary 6 give the non-equivariant ordinary/iterated suspension, but not an Aut(G)-equivariant equivalence or its complete family of geometric subgroup-fixed spaces and orbit spaces. Two inspected published subgroup-fixed models handle complete graphs and C6 reflections respectively, and the published rational-module theorem is also restricted to complete-graph generalized levels; these do not imply a result for every finite graph and all natural lifted automorphism subgroups. The new proof supplies an explicit canonical automorphism-equivariant shadow contraction and homotopy cofiber for arbitrary G. No exact indexed equivalent was found, but publication priority is not certified, and unindexed/global-equivariant earlier formulations are a residual risk.

value.rationale: For an arbitrary graph, a natural chromatic-number-raising operation has a complete integral equivariant homotopy behavior under every naturally lifted graph automorphism group, inducing all-subgroup fixed spaces and all quotients. The base orbit-conflict graph makes it constructive. The iterated five-cycle has ambient S^{r+1}, fivefold-rotation and full-dihedral fixed S^{r-1}, reflection fixed S^r, and contractible full-dihedral quotient for all r≥1, a structurally motivated infinite family invisible to ordinary homology dimensions. This is not an arbitrary numerical slice; only the known ordinary suspension is credited to prior work.
